- **Parents / Ancestors (1):** Magog [bib_magog] (syncretic: Skene Pictish Chronicle pp. 209-252: Picts & Scots from Scythia/Albani (Japheth/Magog/Gomer))

- **Primary Sources:** Skene Chronicles of the Picts & Scots pp. 209-252
- **Notes:** The Pictish Chronicle derives both Scots and Picts from Scythia/Albani (Noah -> Japheth -> Magog/Gomer), recording Cruithne and his seven sons giving their names to the seven provinces of Pictish Scotland.

### [eur_scota_goidel] Nel + Princess Scota (Daughter of Pharaoh!) → Goídel Glas (Gaels)
- **Tradition:** Celtic, Norse, Slavic & European (`europe_norse`, Northern, Eastern & Western Europe)
- **Era / Years:** Lebor Gabála Érenn (Egypt → Spain Bridge) | **Generation Tier:** 10 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 6
- **Role / Title:** Irish-Egyptian Chronicle Bridge (Eponym of Gaels & Scots!)
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Princess Scota of Egypt; Goídel Glas (Gaels)
- **Lineage From Adam:** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Sanchuniathon & Bar Hebraeus Synchronisms: Chrysor/Vulcan (= Tubal-Cain), Misor (= Mizraim), Chna (= Canaan) & 10 Chaldean Kings (Aloros → Ksisothros = Noah) -> Noah (Noach) & Emzara / Naamah -> Japheth (Yefet) & Adataneses -> Magog -> Fénius Farsaid (Scythian Inventor of Gaelic at Babel) → Nel -> Nel + Princess Scota (Daughter of Pharaoh!) → Goídel Glas (Gaels)
- **Parents / Ancestors (4):** Fénius Farsaid (Scythian Inventor of Gaelic at Babel) → Nel [eur_fenius_farsaid] (direct: Fénius Farsaid -> Nel (+ Egyptian Princess Scota) -> Goídel Glas) | Moses (Moshe) [bib_moses] (syncretic: Lebor Gabála Érenn says Moses cured young Goídel Glas of a serpent bite in Egypt before the Exodus!) | Ramesses I → Seti I → Ramesses II the Great (+ Nefertari) [eg_ramesses2] (syncretic: Irish chronicles name Pharaoh's daughter Scota as mother of the Gaels/Scots) | Niul (+ Scota, Dau. of Pharaoh; Friend of Moses!) → Gaodhal Glas (Gael) → Asruth → Sruth → Heber Scot [irl_niul_gaedhal] (cognate: Same Milesian-Scota stem in O'Hart & Lebor Gabála Érenn)
- **Offspring / Successors (1):** Breogán (Spain) → Míl Espáine → Éber Finn, Éremón & Amairgin (Milesians) [eur_milesians] (direct: Goídel Glas -> ... -> Breogán -> Míl Espáine -> Éber Finn & Éremón)
- **Primary Sources:** Lebor Gabála Érenn; Declaration of Arbroath (1320)
- **Notes:** Nel journeys to Egypt, befriends Moses during the Exodus, and marries Princess Scota (daughter of Pharaoh Cingris!). Their son Goídel Glas gives his name to the Gaels (Goidelic Irish & Scottish), while Scota gives her name to Scotland!

- **Tradition:** African, Berber, Sudan & Ethiopian (`african`, North Africa / Nubia / Ethiopia)

- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Ebna la-Hakim; Bayna Lehkem
- **Lineage From Adam:** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Sanchuniathon & Bar Hebraeus Synchronisms: Chrysor/Vulcan (= Tubal-Cain), Misor (= Mizraim), Chna (= Canaan) & 10 Chaldean Kings (Aloros → Ksisothros = Noah) -> Noah (Noach) & Emzara / Naamah -> Raleigh & Methodius's 3 Post-Flood Leaders: Nimrod (Ham), Joktan (Shem) & Suphene (Japheth) -> Joktan (Qahtan) -> Sheba / Saba (son of Joktan) -> Menelik I (Solomonic Dynasty of Ethiopia)
- **Parents / Ancestors (3):** King Solomon (Shlomo) [jud_solomon] (expansion: Kebra Nagast: Solomon + Queen Makeda of Sheba -> Menelik I) | Sheba / Saba (son of Joktan) [bib_sheba_joktan] (expansion: Queen of Sheba (Makeda / Saba) -> mother of Menelik I) | Queen Makeda (Queen of Sheba / Saba / Bilqis) [eth_makeda] (direct: Mother of Menelik I (Kebra Nagast))
- **Offspring / Successors (2):** Zagduru → Bazen → Emperor Ezana & King Kaleb of Aksum [eth_ezana] (expansion: Aksumite Solomonic succession: Menelik I -> Zagduru -> Bazen -> Ezana -> Kaleb) | Mukarrib Karib'il Watar of Saba (Contemporary of Sennacherib, c. 685 BCE) [anc11_karibil_watar_saba] (expansion: South Arabian Saba–Aksumite Sabaean royal horizon)
- **Primary Sources:** Kebra Nagast (Ethiopian National Epic)
- **Notes:** Son of King Solomon and Queen Makeda of Sheba (Saba). Creates a famous African-Arabian-Israelite royal genealogy bridging Cush/Ethiopia, Sheba, and Judah!

- **Offspring / Successors (2):** LIVING (2026): Ethiopian Imperial House — Emperor Haile Selassie I (1892–1975) → Crown Prince Amha Selassie (1916–1997) → Prince Zera Yacob Amha Selassie (b. 1953) & Prince Ermias Sahle Selassie (b. 1960) [mod_eth_living_2026] (direct: Father/Mother-to-child Solomonic succession to 2026) | Gondar Solomonic Emperors (Ludolf 1684): Lebna Dengel → Galawdewos → Emperor Susenyos → Emperor Fasilides (Founder of Gondar, 1632) [eth_ludolf_gondar_kings] (expansion: Ludolf 1684: Solomonic line Lebna Dengel -> Galawdewos -> Susenyos -> Fasilides (Gondar))
- **Primary Sources:** Kebra Nagast; Ethiopian Imperial Chronicles
- **Notes:** Yekuno Amlak restored the Solomonic Dynasty in 1270 CE; continued through Zara Yaqob, Menelik II (victor at Adwa), down to Haile Selassie I (225th ruler from Menelik I!).

### [sng_za_al_ayaman] Za-Al-Ayaman ('Came from Yemen' → Kukya on the Niger) → 14 Pre-Islamic Za Kings → Za-Kosoi (1st Muslim King of Songhai, 1009 CE)
- **Tradition:** African, Berber, Sudan & Ethiopian (`african`, North Africa / Nubia / Ethiopia)
- **Era / Years:** Early Niger Bend → 1010 CE (Tarikh es-Soudan Ch. 1 pp. 35-38) | **Generation Tier:** 18 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 5
- **Role / Title:** Yemeni-Originated Founder of the Songhai Za Dynasty on the Niger
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Za-Al-Ayaman; Dja men el-Yemen; Za-Kosoi (1009 CE)
- **Lineage From Adam:** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Sanchuniathon & Bar Hebraeus Synchronisms: Chrysor/Vulcan (= Tubal-Cain), Misor (= Mizraim), Chna (= Canaan) & 10 Chaldean Kings (Aloros → Ksisothros = Noah) -> Noah (Noach) & Emzara / Naamah -> Raleigh & Methodius's 3 Post-Flood Leaders: Nimrod (Ham), Joktan (Shem) & Suphene (Japheth) -> Joktan (Qahtan) -> Za-Al-Ayaman ('Came from Yemen' → Kukya on the Niger) → 14 Pre-Islamic Za Kings → Za-Kosoi (1st Muslim King of Songhai, 1009 CE)
- **Parents / Ancestors (3):** Joktan (Qahtan) [bib_joktan] (syncretic: Tarikh es-Soudan Ch. 1 pp. 36-38: Za-Al-Ayaman ('dja men el-Yemen') originates in Yemeni / Qahtanite migration to the Niger River) | Pre-Islamic Arab Kingdoms Anchor (Himyarite Tubbas, Lakhmids & Ghassanids) [bir_himyar_lakhmid_ghassan] (syncretic: Yemeni royal dispersion tradition connecting South Arabia to Kukya / Songhai (Tarikh es-Soudan)) | Moses (Moshe) [bib_moses] (syncretic: Tarikh es-Soudan p. 37 records traditional association of Kukya antiquity with Pharaoh's magicians vs. Moses)
- **Offspring / Successors (1):** Songhai Empire & Timbuktu: Sonni Ali-Kolon → Sonni Ali (1464) → Askia El-Hadj Mohammed (Askia the Great, 1493) [sng_sonni_askia_timbuktu] (direct: Tarikh es-Soudan Ch. 2-3 pp. 39-44: Za-Yasiboy -> Sonni Ali-Kolon -> Sonni Ali -> Askia El-Hadj Mohammed)
- **Primary Sources:** Abderrahman es-Sa'di Tarikh es-Soudan (tr. Houdas 1900) Ch. 1 pp. 35-38
- **Notes:** Tarikh es-Soudan derives the royal Za (Dia) dynasty of Kukya/Songhai from two brothers who traveled from Yemen ('dja men el-Yemen' -> Za-Al-Ayaman), slaying the pagan river-idol and ruling through 14 pre-Islamic kings until Za-Kosoi (Moslem-dam) embraced Islam in AH 400 (1009-1010 CE).

- **Primary Sources:** Betham 1795 Tab. XC-XCI; Sallust Jugurtha; Plutarch
- **Notes:** Masinissa unified Numidia (ally of Scipio Africanus against Hannibal); his grandson Jugurtha resisted Rome. Later King Juba II of Mauretania married Cleopatra Selene II (daughter of Mark Antony & Cleopatra VII of Egypt!), fathering King Ptolemy of Mauretania — uniting Berber, Ptolemaic Egyptian, and Roman bloodlines!

### [le_sanchuniathon] Protogonos → Misor & Sydyk → Taaut (Thoth) & Chna (Canaan)
- **Tradition:** Egyptian & Canaanite-Phoenician (`levant_egypt`, Nile / Eastern Mediterranean)
- **Era / Years:** Phoenician-Canaanite Lore | **Generation Tier:** 6 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 4
- **Role / Title:** Phoenician Genealogy Bridging Egypt & Levant
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Misor = Mizraim; Taaut = Thoth; Chna = Canaan
- **Lineage From Adam:** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Pirkei de-Rabbi Eliezer: Adam → Enoch → Shem Intercalation & 7-Epoch Covenant -> Shem (Sem) & Sedeqetelebab -> Melchizedek (King & Priest of Salem) -> Protogonos → Misor & Sydyk → Taaut (Thoth) & Chna (Canaan)
- **Parents / Ancestors (3):** Mizraim (Egypt) [bib_mizraim] (cognate: Biblical Mizraim = Phoenician Misor) | Canaan [bib_canaan] (cognate: Biblical Canaan = Phoenician Chna) | Cadmus (Founder of Thebes) & Harmonia [grk_cadmus] (cognate: Herodotus V.58: Cadmus brings Phoenician alphabet (cf. Taaut/Thoth) to Greece!)
- **Offspring / Successors (2):** Thoth (Djehuty / Hermes) & King Saurid (Surid) [eg_thoth_saurid] (cognate: Phoenician Taaut = Egyptian Thoth) | Melchizedek (King & Priest of Salem) [bib_melchizedek] (cognate: Phoenician Sydyk ('Righteousness') <-> Melchi-zedek ('King of Righteousness'))
- **Primary Sources:** Philo of Byblos / Sanchuniathon (via Eusebius Praep. Ev. I.10)
- **Notes:** Explicitly names Misor (direct cognate of Biblical Mizraim!) as brother of Sydyk (cf. Melchizedek) and father of Taaut (Egyptian Thoth), alongside Chna (Canaan).

### [eg_menes] Narmer / Menes (Unifier of Upper & Lower Egypt)
- **Tradition:** Egyptian & Canaanite-Phoenician (`levant_egypt`, Nile / Eastern Mediterranean)
- **Era / Years:** Dynasty 1 (c. 3100 BCE) | **Generation Tier:** 6 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 5
- **Role / Title:** First Historical Pharaoh of Unified Egypt
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Narmer; Menes; Scorpion II precursor
- **Lineage From Adam:** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Sanchuniathon & Bar Hebraeus Synchronisms: Chrysor/Vulcan (= Tubal-Cain), Misor (= Mizraim), Chna (= Canaan) & 10 Chaldean Kings (Aloros → Ksisothros = Noah) -> Noah (Noach) & Emzara / Naamah -> Ham (Cham) & Na'eltama'uk -> Mizraim (Egypt) -> Narmer / Menes (Unifier of Upper & Lower Egypt)
- **Parents / Ancestors (4):** Horus (Heru) & Shemsu-Hor ('Followers of Horus') [eg_horus] (expansion: Turin King List: Horus -> Shemsu-Hor -> Narmer/Menes) | Mizraim (Egypt) [bib_mizraim] (cognate: Biblical Mizraim = Egypt (land unified by Narmer/Menes)) | Epaphus (King of Egypt) & Queen Memphis [grk_epaphus] (parallel: Epaphus King of Egypt (husband of Memphis) <-> Memphite Egyptian kingship) | King Scorpion I/II & Palermo Stone Lower Egypt Kings (Dynasty 0) [eg_palermo_predynastic] (direct: Dynasty 0 -> Unification under Narmer/Menes)
- **Offspring / Successors (2):** Hor-Aha → Djer → Djet & Queen Merneith [eg_hor_aha] (direct: Son Hor-Aha -> Djer -> Djet & Merneith) | Dynasty I Horizon (Thinite, 8 Kings, c. 2982–2803 BCE) [eg_dyn1_complete] (direct: Manetho & Budge Chronological Framework)
- **Primary Sources:** Narmer Palette; Abydos King List; Turin King List; Manetho
- **Notes:** Unified Upper and Lower Egypt and founded Memphis (city of Ptah); historical anchor for the land of Mizraim.

### [eg_khufu] Khufu (Cheops) — Great Pyramid of Giza
- **Tradition:** Egyptian & Canaanite-Phoenician (`levant_egypt`, Nile / Eastern Mediterranean)
- **Era / Years:** Dynasty 4 (c. 2589-2566 BCE) | **Generation Tier:** 8 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 5
- **Role / Title:** Builder of the Great Pyramid
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Cheops
- **Lineage From Adam:** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Sanchuniathon & Bar Hebraeus Synchronisms: Chrysor/Vulcan (= Tubal-Cain), Misor (= Mizraim), Chna (= Canaan) & 10 Chaldean Kings (Aloros → Ksisothros = Noah) -> Noah (Noach) & Emzara / Naamah -> Hujib → Philemon (Aflimun, Egyptian Priest on Noah's Ark) -> Thoth (Djehuty / Hermes) & King Saurid (Surid) -> Khufu (Cheops) — Great Pyramid of Giza
- **Parents / Ancestors (2):** Huni → Sneferu & Queen Hetepheres I [eg_sneferu] (direct: Sneferu + Hetepheres I -> Khufu) | Thoth (Djehuty / Hermes) & King Saurid (Surid) [eg_thoth_saurid] (syncretic: Coptic-Arabic lore attributes Giza Pyramids to Saurid/Enoch before the Flood)
- **Offspring / Successors (2):** Djedefre, Khafre (Sphinx) → Menkaure → Shepseskaf [eg_khafre_menkaure] (direct: Sons Djedefre & Khafre -> Menkaure -> Shepseskaf) | Djedefre / Ratoises (Dyn. IV) [egr_d3_6_05_djedefre_ratoises_dyn_iv] (direct: Old Kingdom Succession (Dyn. III–VI))

- **Notes:** Son of Sneferu & Hetepheres I; commissioned the Great Pyramid of Giza (attributed in Coptic-Arabic folklore to antediluvian King Saurid/Enoch!). Father of Djedefre and Khafre.

- **Parents / Ancestors (4):** Akhenaten (Amenhotep IV) & Nefertiti [eg_akhenaten] (parallel: Comparative historians link Manetho's Osarseph memory to Amarna/Akhenaten monotheism) | Moses (Moshe) [bib_moses] (syncretic: Manetho's Osarseph, Artapanus's Musaeus & Jasher's King of Cush) | Rikayon (First 'Pharaoh' in Book of Jasher) → Melol → Adikam [eg_jas_rikayon] (expansion: Jasher 68: Pharaoh Melol's daughter Bithiah rescues and raises Moses) | King Kikanos of Cush (+ Queen Adoniah) → Menakrus [af_jas_kikanos] (expansion: Jasher 73: Moses marries Queen Adoniah and rules Cush 40 years)
- **Offspring / Successors (0):** None / Terminal Leaf
- **Primary Sources:** Manetho (via Josephus Against Apion 1.26); Artapanus (via Eusebius); Book of Jasher 68, 72-76
- **Notes:** Manetho preserves an Egyptian tradition of a Heliopolitan priest named Osarseph who took the name Moses; Artapanus calls Moses 'Musaeus' (teacher of Orpheus) and Egyptian 'Hermes', leading an expedition into Cush/Ethiopia — echoing Book of Jasher 72-76 where Moses rules Cush with Queen Adoniah!

### [grk_chaos_gaia] Chaos → Gaia (Earth) & Uranus (Sky)
- **Tradition:** Greek & Mediterranean (`greek`, Aegean / Anatolia / Italy)
- **Era / Years:** Primordial Cosmogony (Hesiod Theogony) | **Generation Tier:** 1 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 5
- **Role / Title:** Primordial Greek Progenitors
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** None

Book of Jasher 3:1 names his 3 sons (Methuselah, Elisha, Elimelech) and 2 daughters (Melca, Nahmah/Naamah). Widely equated in Greco-Egyptian & Arabic lore with Thoth/Hermes/King Saurid and compared to 7th Sumerian king Enmeduranki!

- **Era / Years:** Post-Flood Dispersion (Raleigh 1736 Vol. 1 Book I Ch. VII p. 69; Petavius 1659) | **Generation Tier:** 6 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 3
- **Role / Title:** Tripartite Dispersion Commanders of Ham, Shem & Japheth
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Methodius of Tyre; Suphene; Petavius 1659
- **Lineage From Adam:** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Sanchuniathon & Bar Hebraeus Synchronisms: Chrysor/Vulcan (= Tubal-Cain), Misor (= Mizraim), Chna (= Canaan) & 10 Chaldean Kings (Aloros → Ksisothros = Noah) -> Noah (Noach) & Emzara / Naamah -> Raleigh & Methodius's 3 Post-Flood Leaders: Nimrod (Ham), Joktan (Shem) & Suphene (Japheth)

### [jud_solomon] King Solomon (Shlomo)
- **Tradition:** Biblical & Extra-Biblical (`biblical`, Levant / Ancient Near East)
- **Era / Years:** United Monarchy (c. 970-931 BCE) | **Generation Tier:** 16 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 5
- **Role / Title:** Builder of the First Temple
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Shlomo; Sulayman

### [ar_adnan_quraysh] Adnan → Ma'add → Nizar → Quraysh → Muhammad
- **Tradition:** Arabian (Adnanite & Qahtanite) (`arabian`, Arabian Peninsula)
- **Era / Years:** Classical Arabia → 7th c. CE | **Generation Tier:** 12 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 6
- **Role / Title:** Northern Arabian (Adnanite) & Prophetic Lineage
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Adnanites; Banu Hashim
- **Lineage From Adam:** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Sanchuniathon & Bar Hebraeus Synchronisms: Chrysor/Vulcan (= Tubal-Cain), Misor (= Mizraim), Chna (= Canaan) & 10 Chaldean Kings (Aloros → Ksisothros = Noah) -> Noah (Noach) & Emzara / Naamah -> Raleigh & Methodius's 3 Post-Flood Leaders: Nimrod (Ham), Joktan (Shem) & Suphene (Japheth) -> Joktan (Qahtan) -> Pre-Islamic Arabian Tribal Tree (Caussin de Perceval Vol. 1): Qahtan (Himyar, Kahlan, Azd, Kindah) & Adnan (Ma'add → Nizar → Mudar & Rabi'a) -> Adnan → Ma'add → Nizar → Quraysh → Muhammad
- **Parents / Ancestors (2):** Kedar (Qaydar) [ish_kedar] (expansion: Arabian genealogical bridge via Qaydar/Adnan) | Nebaioth (Nabit) [ish_nebaioth] (expansion: Alternate Arabian tradition via Nabit/Adnan)
- **Offspring / Successors (5):** Bilali Bounama → Naré Maghann → Sundiata Keita → Mansa Musa [af_sundiata] (syncretic: Mande griot chronicles link Keita ancestor Bilali Bounama to Ethiopian Bilal (companion of Muhammad)) | Qusayy → Hashim → Abd al-Muttalib → Prophet Muhammad (570–632 CE) → Fatimah & Ali, Umayyads & Abbasids [ar_hashim_muhammad_caliphs] (direct: Adnan -> Fihr (Quraysh) -> Qusayy -> Hashim -> Abd al-Muttalib -> Prophet Muhammad) | Complete 21-Gen Quraysh Lineage (Tabari Vol. 6): Adnan → Ma'add → Nizar → Mudar → Ilyas → Mudrikah → Khuzaymah → Kinanah → al-Nadr → Malik → Fihr (Quraysh) → Ghalib → Lu'ayy → Ka'b → Murrah → Kilab → Qusayy → 'Abd Manaf → Hashim → 'Abd al-Muttalib → 'Abdallah [tab_adnan_21gen_quraysh] (direct: Tabari Vol. 6 pp. 1-44; Lane-Poole; Zambaur: Full 21-generation unbroken pedigree to Prophet Muhammad) | Pre-Islamic Arabian Tribal Tree (Caussin de Perceval Vol. 1): Qahtan (Himyar, Kahlan, Azd, Kindah) & Adnan (Ma'add → Nizar → Mudar & Rabi'a) [cdp_qahtan_adnan_tribes] (cognate: Same Adnan -> Ma'add -> Nizar northern Arab tribal genealogy) | Ma'add ibn Adnan (Son of Adnan) [ar4_maadd] (direct: Adnan -> son Ma'add)
- **Primary Sources:** Ibn Ishaq Sirah; al-Tabari History; Ibn al-Kalbi
- **Notes:** Classical Arabian genealogies trace the Northern Arabs from Ishmael (via Kedar/Nebaioth) through Adnan -> Ma'add -> Nizar -> Mudar -> Fihr (Quraysh) -> Qusayy -> Abd Manaf -> Hashim -> Abd al-Muttalib -> Abdullah -> Muhammad.

### [mes_uruk_gilgamesh] Gilgamesh (Bilgamesh of Uruk / Erech)
- **Tradition:** Mesopotamian (Sumer / Akkad) (`mesopotamian`, Mesopotamia)
- **Era / Years:** Early Dynastic II (c. 2700 BCE) | **Generation Tier:** 7 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 4
- **Role / Title:** 5th King of Uruk / Builder of Uruk's Walls / Qumran Giant
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Bilgamesh; Erech (Gen 10:10); Gilgamesh in Qumran 4Q530
- **Lineage From Adam:** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Sanchuniathon & Bar Hebraeus Synchronisms: Chrysor/Vulcan (= Tubal-Cain), Misor (= Mizraim), Chna (= Canaan) & 10 Chaldean Kings (Aloros → Ksisothros = Noah) -> Gautruche's Poetical History Cognates: Golden Age (Saturn/Janus = Noah), Silver Age (Jupiter = Ham), Brazen Age (Nimrod), Vulcan (= Tubal-Cain) & Apollo (= Jubal) -> Nimrod (Mighty Hunter of Shinar) -> Gilgamesh (Bilgamesh of Uruk / Erech)
- **Parents / Ancestors (3):** Lugalbanda & Goddess Ninsun [mes_lugalbanda] (direct: Lugalbanda + Ninsun -> Gilgamesh (Epic of Gilgamesh)) | Nimrod (Mighty Hunter of Shinar) [bib_nimrod] (cognate: Gen 10:10 explicitly names Shinar, Babel & Erech (Uruk)) | Ohya & Hahya (Nephilim Giants) [eno_ohya_hahya] (expansion: Qumran Book of Giants (4Q530/4Q531) literally names Gilgamesh as a Giant!)
- **Offspring / Successors (2):** 10. Ziusudra / Utnapishtim / Atrahasis [mes_ziusudra] (expansion: Epic of Gilgamesh XI: Gilgamesh visits Flood survivor Utnapishtim) | Ur-Nungal (son of Gilgamesh) [mes_urnungal] (direct: Son (Sumerian King List))
- **Primary Sources:** Sumerian King List; Epic of Gilgamesh; Qumran Book of Giants (4Q530)
- **Notes:** Son of Lugalbanda & Ninsun; visits Flood survivor Utnapishtim. Uruk is explicitly 'Erech' in Gen 10:10 — and 'Gilgamesh' is literally named as a Giant in Qumran Book of Giants (4Q530)!

### [mes_sargon] Sargon of Akkad (Sharru-kin)
- **Tradition:** Mesopotamian (Sumer / Akkad) (`mesopotamian`, Mesopotamia)
- **Era / Years:** Akkadian Empire (c. 2334-2279 BCE) | **Generation Tier:** 8 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 4
- **Role / Title:** Founder of Akkad (Biblical Accad)
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Sharru-kin; Accad (Gen 10:10)
- **Lineage From Adam:** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Sanchuniathon & Bar Hebraeus Synchronisms: Chrysor/Vulcan (= Tubal-Cain), Misor (= Mizraim), Chna (= Canaan) & 10 Chaldean Kings (Aloros → Ksisothros = Noah) -> Gautruche's Poetical History Cognates: Golden Age (Saturn/Janus = Noah), Silver Age (Jupiter = Ham), Brazen Age (Nimrod), Vulcan (= Tubal-Cain) & Apollo (= Jubal) -> Nimrod (Mighty Hunter of Shinar) -> Sargon of Akkad (Sharru-kin)
- **Parents / Ancestors (4):** Mesh-ki-ang-nanna (son of Mesannepada) [mes_meshkiangnanna] (expansion: Sumerian King List succession to Akkad) | Nimrod (Mighty Hunter of Shinar) [bib_nimrod] (cognate: Gen 10:10 explicitly names Accad (Akkad) & Nineveh) | Moses (Moshe) [bib_moses] (parallel: Reed basket sealed with bitumen placed in river (Exod 2 <-> Sargon Birth Legend)) | Uruk III: King Lugal-zagesi (25 yrs — First Unifier of Sumer Before Sargon) [skl_uruk3_lugalzagesi] (expansion: Sargon of Akkad (former cupbearer of Ur-Zababa) defeats Lugal-zagesi)
- **Offspring / Successors (5):** Enheduanna (High Priestess of Ur) [mes_enheduanna] (direct: Daughter of Sargon (Disk of Enheduanna)) | Rimush (son of Sargon) [mes_rimush] (direct: Son of Sargon (SKL)) | Manishtushu (son of Sargon) [mes_manishtushu] (direct: Son of Sargon (SKL)) | Sargon & Naram-Sin of Agade (Chronicle of Early Kings) [arc12_sharru_kin_babylon] (expansion: Babylonian Chronicle Attestation) | Kings Ilushuma & Puzur-Ashur I of Assyria [arc12_puzur_ashur1_assyria] (expansion: Early Assyro-Babylonian Synchronism)
- **Primary Sources:** Sumerian King List; Birth Legend of Sargon
- **Notes:** Cupbearer of Ur-Zababa of Kish who founded the world's first empire (Biblical Accad, Gen 10:10). His Birth Legend ('reed basket sealed with bitumen on the river') parallels Moses in Exodus 2!

- **Parents / Ancestors (1):** Uruk II (Enshakushanna), Ur II (Kaku), Adab (Lugal-annemundu) & Mari (Ansud) [skl_uruk2_ur2_adab_mari] (expansion: Dynastic / Genealogical Succession)

### [mes_assyria_kings] Tudiya → Ushpia → Shamshi-Adad I → Tukulti-Ninurta I → Ashurbanipal
- **Tradition:** Mesopotamian (Sumer / Akkad) (`mesopotamian`, Mesopotamia)
- **Era / Years:** Assyrian King List (c. 2100-627 BCE) | **Generation Tier:** 10 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 4
- **Role / Title:** Kings of Assyria (Biblical Asshur / Nineveh)
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Asshur (Gen 10:11, 22); Tukulti-Ninurta I <-> Nimrod
- **Lineage From Adam:** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> 2. Adamu (2nd Assyrian Tent-King) -> 1. Tudiya (1st Assyrian Tent-King) -> Asshur -> Tudiya → Ushpia → Shamshi-Adad I → Tukulti-Ninurta I → Ashurbanipal
- **Parents / Ancestors (4):** Nimrod (Mighty Hunter of Shinar) [bib_nimrod] (parallel: Assyriologists compare Nimrod to Tukulti-Ninurta I, conqueror of Babylon) | Asshur [bib_asshur] (cognate: Biblical Asshur = historical Assyria (Ashur & Nineveh)) | Shebitku & Taharqa (Biblical Tirhakah, King of Cush!) [af_taharqa] (cognate: 2 Kings 19:9: Taharqa (Tirhakah) marches against Assyrian king Sennacherib to aid Jerusalem!) | Sargonid Dynasty Anchor (Sargon II to Ashur-uballit II) [akl_110_116_sargonids] (direct: Completes the Assyrian royal succession)
- **Offspring / Successors (1):** Tiglath-Pileser III (Pul) → Sennacherib → Esarhaddon → Ashurbanipal [for_neo_assyria] (direct: Neo-Assyrian royal line -> Sennacherib -> Esarhaddon -> Ashurbanipal)
- **Primary Sources:** Assyrian King List; Library of Ashurbanipal
- **Notes:** Begins with '17 Kings Who Lived in Tents' (Tudiya -> Ushpia) and leads to Tukulti-Ninurta I (often cited as a historical prototype for Nimrod!), Sennacherib, and Ashurbanipal (whose library preserved Gilgamesh & Enuma Elish!).

- **Offspring / Successors (1):** Nahusha → Emperor Yayati (+ Devayani & Sharmishtha) [ved_yayati] (direct: Shukracharya (Kavi Ushanas)'s daughter Devayani marries Yayati)
- **Primary Sources:** Rigveda 1.105, 10.8, 10.99
- **Notes:** Vedic dragon-slayer Trita son of Aptya is the exact cognate of Avestan Thraetaona (Fereydun) son of Athwya (Abtin), while sage Kavi Ushanas (Shukracharya, father of Yayati's wife Devayani!) is the exact cognate of Iranian King Kavi Usan (Kay Kavus)!

- **Notes:** Son of Yayati & Sharmishtha; ancestor of King Gandhara (eponym of Gandhara / NW Pakistan-Afghanistan) and Prachetas, whose 100 sons migrate north/west across the Indus into Central Asia (Mleccha kingdoms) in Puranic ethnography!

- **Tradition:** India, Kashmir, Ceylon, Burma & Tibet (`vedic`, South Asia & Himalayas)

- **Role / Title:** Founder of Buddhism (Solar / Ikshvaku Lineage)
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Gautama Buddha; Shakyamuni; Son: Rahula
- **Lineage From Adam:** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Sanchuniathon & Bar Hebraeus Synchronisms: Chrysor/Vulcan (= Tubal-Cain), Misor (= Mizraim), Chna (= Canaan) & 10 Chaldean Kings (Aloros → Ksisothros = Noah) -> Noah (Noach) & Emzara / Naamah -> Vaivasvata Manu (Shraddhadeva — 7th Manu) -> Ikshvaku (Okkaka — Founder of Solar Dynasty) -> Shakya Clan (Okkaka) → King Shuddhodana (+ Maya) → Siddhartha Gautama (The Buddha)
- **Parents / Ancestors (5):** Ikshvaku (Okkaka — Founder of Solar Dynasty) [ved_ikshvaku] (expansion: Pali Canon (Ambattha Sutta / Mahavamsa): Okkaka (Ikshvaku) -> Shakya Clan -> Shuddhodana -> Gautama Buddha!) | Ayodhya Post-Rama Spine Anchor (Gens 66–95: Kusha to Brihatkshaya) [ind_ayodhya_late_66_95] (expansion: Solar Aikshvaku continuation -> Shakya Clan -> Gautama Buddha) | Historical Magadha Anchor (22 Barhadrathas → Pradyotas → Shishunaga/Bimbisara → 9 Nandas) [ind_magadha_bimbisara_nanda] (cognate: King Bimbisara & Ajatashatru of Magadha: patrons of Gautama Buddha (c. 487 BCE)) | Brihatkshaya (Gen 95, Son of Brihadbala) [indr_ay3_28_brihatkshaya_gen_95] (expansion: Post-Rama Aikshvaku continuation to Gautama Buddha) | King Mahāsammata (= Manu) → Okkaka (= Ikshvaku) → Śākya Royal Stem [ind_mahasammata_okkaka] (direct: Okkaka / Ikshvaku -> Śākya clan -> King Shuddhodana -> Siddhartha Gautama Buddha)
- **Offspring / Successors (3):** Empress Jingu → Emperor Ojin (Hachiman) → Emperor Nintoku → Prince Shotoku [jpn_jingu_ojin] (cognate: Buddhism spreads from India through China & Baekje Korea to Prince Shotoku's Japan!) | Magadha (Jarasandha → Bimbisara) → Chandragupta Maurya → Emperor Ashoka [ved_maurya_ashoka] (expansion: Emperor Ashoka champions Gautama Buddha's Dharma across Sri Lanka, Central Asia & the Mediterranean) | Sri Lanka (Mahavamsa): Prince Vijaya (1st King of Lanka, 543 BCE) & Thera Mahinda (Son of Ashoka) [ceylon_vijaya_mahinda] (expansion: Mahavamsa Ch. II-VII: Vijaya arrives on the day of Buddha's Parinirvana; Mahinda son of Ashoka brings Buddhism to Lanka)
- **Primary Sources:** Digha Nikaya (Ambattha Sutta); Mahavamsa Ch. 2; Buddhacarita
- **Notes:** Buddhist chronicles trace the Shakya clan directly to King Okkaka (= Ikshvaku of the Solar Dynasty)! Siddhartha Gautama (son of Shuddhodana & Maya; father of Rahula via Yasodhara) sparks a pan-Asian movement reaching China, Korea, and Japan!

### [ved_maurya_ashoka] Magadha (Jarasandha → Bimbisara) → Chandragupta Maurya → Emperor Ashoka
- **Tradition:** India, Kashmir, Ceylon, Burma & Tibet (`vedic`, South Asia & Himalayas)
- **Era / Years:** Mauryan Empire (322-232 BCE) | **Generation Tier:** 13 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 6
- **Role / Title:** Unifier of India & Global Inscription Bridge (Greece, Egypt & Asia!)
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Ashoka Rock Edict XIII; Chandragupta Maurya
- **Lineage From Adam:** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Sanchuniathon & Bar Hebraeus Synchronisms: Chrysor/Vulcan (= Tubal-Cain), Misor (= Mizraim), Chna (= Canaan) & 10 Chaldean Kings (Aloros → Ksisothros = Noah) -> Noah (Noach) & Emzara / Naamah -> Vaivasvata Manu (Shraddhadeva — 7th Manu) -> Ikshvaku (Okkaka — Founder of Solar Dynasty) -> Shakya Clan (Okkaka) → King Shuddhodana (+ Maya) → Siddhartha Gautama (The Buddha) -> Magadha (Jarasandha → Bimbisara) → Chandragupta Maurya → Emperor Ashoka
- **Parents / Ancestors (6):** Abhimanyu (+ Uttara) → King Parikshit → King Janamejaya [ved_parikshit_janamejaya] (expansion: Vishnu Purana IV.24 royal chronology -> Magadha -> Mauryan Empire -> Ashoka) | Alexander the Great (Macedon → Persia, Egypt & India) [grk_alexander] (cognate: Chandragupta Maurya defeats Seleucus I (305 BCE) & seals Seleucid marriage treaty (Megasthenes)) | Shakya Clan (Okkaka) → King Shuddhodana (+ Maya) → Siddhartha Gautama (The Buddha) [ved_buddha] (expansion: Emperor Ashoka champions Gautama Buddha's Dharma across Sri Lanka, Central Asia & the Mediterranean) | Historical Magadha Anchor (22 Barhadrathas → Pradyotas → Shishunaga/Bimbisara → 9 Nandas) [ind_magadha_bimbisara_nanda] (expansion: Chandragupta Maurya overthrows the 9 Nandas (322 BCE)) | Emperor Mahapadma Nanda (Founder of Nanda Empire) [indr_ail_30_mahapadma_nanda_nanda_empire] (expansion: Chandragupta Maurya overthrows Nandas) | Greco-Bactrian & Indo-Greek Kings: Diodotus I → Euthydemus → Demetrius I → Menander I (King Milinda) [cls_bactria_menander] (cognate: Indo-Greek King Menander I (Milinda) embraces Buddhism in post-Mauryan India)
- **Offspring / Successors (7):** Ptolemy I → Ptolemy II (Manetho & LXX) → Cleopatra VII [eg_ptolemy_cleopatra] (cognate: Ashoka Rock Edict XIII (c. 256 BCE) explicitly names Ptolemy II of Egypt (Turamaya) as recipient of Dharma envoys!) | Gupta Empire Anchor (Sri Gupta → Chandragupta I → Samudragupta → Vikramaditya → Skandagupta) [ind_gupta_golden_age] (expansion: Post-Mauryan imperial succession -> Gupta Golden Age of Magadha) | Kashmir Kings (Kalhana's Rajatarangini): Gonanda I (Kurukshetra) → Ashoka of Kashmir [kas_gonanda_ashoka] (cognate: Kalhana's Rajatarangini Book I (Stein): Kashmir chronology anchored to Pandavas/Kurukshetra & Emperor Ashoka (who links historically to Ptolemy II!)) | Sri Lanka (Mahavamsa): Prince Vijaya (1st King of Lanka, 543 BCE) & Thera Mahinda (Son of Ashoka) [ceylon_vijaya_mahinda] (direct: Son Mahinda & daughter Sanghamitta of Emperor Ashoka) | Classical & Early Modern Indian Empires: Chandragupta I → Samudragupta → Chandragupta II (Guptas); Rajaraja Chola I → Rajendra Chola I (Cholas!); Krishnadevaraya; Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj → Sambhaji [pc_india_gupta_chola_maratha] (expansion: Classical Indian Imperial continuity -> Guptas -> Cholas -> Vijayanagara -> Marathas) | Asian Classical Masters: Laozi, Sun Tzu, Mencius, Sima Qian (Shiji), Li Bai; Chanakya, Kalidasa, Adi Shankara & Miyamoto Musashi [fam_asian_sages] (direct: Chanakya (advisor to Chandragupta Maurya) & classical Indian sages) | Emperor Chandragupta Maurya (Founder of Maurya Empire, r. 322–297 BCE) [ind5_chandragupta_maurya] (direct: Mauryan Imperial Succession)
- **Primary Sources:** Vishnu Purana IV.24; Ashoka Rock Edict XIII (c. 256 BCE); Megasthenes Indica
- **Notes:** Chandragupta Maurya (mentored by Chanakya) defeats Alexander's successor Seleucus I (305 BCE) and seals a marriage alliance with the Seleucid house! His grandson Emperor Ashoka the Great explicitly names Ptolemy II of Egypt, Antiochus II of Syria, and Macedon in Rock Edict XIII while sending Buddhist missions across Asia!

### [abg_ergenekon_borte] Il Khan → Qiyan & Nukuz (Ergenekon / Irgana-kon) → Bertezena (Börte Čino) → Alan Qo'a → Dutumin → Kaidu → Tumana → Kabul → Bortan → Yesugei
- **Tradition:** Eurasian Steppe / Turkic (`steppe`, Inner Asia / Eurasian Steppe)
- **Era / Years:** Ergenekon Refuge to 12th c. CE (Abulghazi pp. 82-120) | **Generation Tier:** 18 | **Major Landmark:** No | **Steps From Adam:** 5
- **Role / Title:** Restoration from the Ergenekon Valley to the Borjigin Forefathers of Genghis Khan
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Il Khan; Qiyan & Nukuz; Ergenekon; Yesugei
- **Lineage From Adam:** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Gayomart (Gaya Maretan / Keyumars) -> Oghuz Khan's Monotheistic Restoration & Steppe Nations (Uighurs, Kanglis, Kipchaks, Karluks & 24 Oghuz Tribes) -> Turk (Oljai Khan) → Tatar & Mongol → Oghuz Khagan -> 6 Sons of Oghuz: Gün (Sun), Ay (Moon), Yildiz, Gök, Dağ & Deniz -> Il Khan → Qiyan & Nukuz (Ergenekon / Irgana-kon) → Bertezena (Börte Čino) → Alan Qo'a → Dutumin → Kaidu → Tumana → Kabul → Bortan → Yesugei
- **Parents / Ancestors (1):** 6 Sons of Oghuz: Gün (Sun), Ay (Moon), Yildiz, Gök, Dağ & Deniz [stp_oghuz_six] (expansion: Abulghazi pp. 82-120: 6 sons of Oghuz -> Mengli -> Il Khan (Ergenekon refuge) -> Bertezena (Börte Čino) -> Yesugei)
- **Offspring / Successors (1):** 20. Temüjin / Činggis Qa'an (Genghis Khan, 1162–1227) & Empress Börte [mng_genghis_khan_borte] (expansion: Abulghazi p. 120: Yesugei -> Genghis Khan (Zingis Chan) alongside Secret History of the Mongols)
- **Primary Sources:** Abulghazi Bahadur Khan General History of the Turks pp. 82-120
- **Notes:** After the defeat of Il Khan, survivors Qiyan and Nukuz took refuge in the enclosed valley of Ergenekon (Irgana-kon) for generations until Bertezena (Börte Čino) led the Mongols back out onto the steppe, continuing through Alan Qo'a, Dutumin, Kaidu, Tumana, Kabul, Bortan, and Yesugei.

- **Parents / Ancestors (2):** 6 Sons of Oghuz: Gün (Sun), Ay (Moon), Yildiz, Gök, Dağ & Deniz [stp_oghuz_six] (expansion: Oghuz-Qiniq Seljuk succession from Seljuk & Mikail to Tughril Beg & Alp Arslan) | Magog [bib_magog] (syncretic: Knolles Vol. 1 pp. 2-15 derives the early Turks from Scythia near the Tanais/Caucasus (Magog horizon))

Figurists (Bouvet) compared Noah to Fuxi) | 'Abur (Amur) b. Japheth → Yarej → Na'ur → Lotsatis (1st King of China at Anku) [chn_masudi_abur_lotsatis] (syncretic: Cross-cultural chronicler synchronization of China's Noahic founding era) | Yonton / Jonitus (Yônṭôn — 4th Son of Noah) [syr_yonton_4th_son] (syncretic: Cave of Treasures p. 143: Noah sent 4th son Yonton (Jonitus) to the Far East ('Land of the Rising Sun')) | Noah (Noach) & Emzara / Naamah [bib_noah] (syncretic: John Jackson 1752 Chronological Antiquities & James Anderson 1732: 18th-c. universal chronography identifying Chinese sovereign Fo-hi (Fuxi) with Noah)

### [chn_weizi_confucius] Weizi Qi (Duke of Song) → Kong He → Confucius (Kong Qiu)
- **Tradition:** Ancient Chinese (Sinitic) (`chinese`, East Asia / Yellow River)
- **Era / Years:** Zhou / Spring & Autumn (551-479 BCE) | **Generation Tier:** 9 | **Major Landmark:** Yes | **Steps From Adam:** 7
- **Role / Title:** Shang Royal Descendant & China's Great Sage
- **Alt / Cognate Names:** Kongzi; Kong Qiu
- **Lineage From Adam:** Adam & Eve (Hawwah) -> Sanchuniathon & Bar Hebraeus Synchronisms: Chrysor/Vulcan (= Tubal-Cain), Misor (= Mizraim), Chna (= Canaan) & 10 Chaldean Kings (Aloros → Ksisothros = Noah) -> Noah (Noach) & Emzara / Naamah -> Vaivasvata Manu (Shraddhadeva — 7th Manu) -> Ikshvaku (Okkaka — Founder of Solar Dynasty) -> Shakya Clan (Okkaka) → King Shuddhodana (+ Maya) → Siddhartha Gautama (The Buddha) -> Empress Jingu → Emperor Ojin (Hachiman) → Emperor Nintoku → Prince Shotoku -> Weizi Qi (Duke of Song) → Kong He → Confucius (Kong Qiu)
- **Parents / Ancestors (1):** Di Xin (King Zhou of Shang) — Final Shang King [chn_dixin] (direct: Brother Weizi Qi (Duke of Song) -> ... -> Kong He -> Confucius (Shiji Ch. 47!))
- **Offspring / Successors (4):** Empress Jingu → Emperor Ojin (Hachiman) → Emperor Nintoku → Prince Shotoku [jpn_jingu_ojin] (cognate: Confucius's Analects transmitted via Baekje to Emperor Ojin's court in Japan (Kojiki/Nihon Shoki)) | Asian Classical Masters: Laozi, Sun Tzu, Mencius, Sima Qian (Shiji), Li Bai; Chanakya, Kalidasa, Adi Shankara & Miyamoto Musashi [fam_asian_sages] (direct: Confucius/Mencius/Sima Qian classical Chinese scholarly tradition) | Duke Xiang of Song (Zi Zifu, r. 650 - 637 BCE) [shj13_duke_xiang_song] (direct: Shang Royal House of Song) | Master Yan Ying of Qi & Mencius (Meng Ke) [shj13_yan_ying_mencius] (expansion: Confucian Transmission (Zisi -> Mencius))
- **Primary Sources:** Shiji Ch. 38 & Ch. 47 (Kongzi Shijia); Analects
- **Notes:** Sima Qian's Shiji Ch. 47 traces Confucius (Kong Qiu) directly back through the Dukes of Song to Weizi Qi (brother of Di Xin) -> Shang Dynasty -> Xie -> Di Ku -> Yellow Emperor!
